Sub: Reconciliation of Transfer-in cases received through NEFT.

Sir/Madam,

A number of references have been received from the field offices wherein the
‘Annexure-K’ number was not reflected in the bank statement and the receipts were
reflected as ‘bulk posting of salary’. This required manual intervention at field offices to
reconcile the amount received against ‘Annexure-K’.

2 The matter has been taken up with the State Bank of India. The State Bank of
India, in this regard, has provided a solution through its new trickle feed file mechanism.
The copy of the SBI letter dated 31.12.2015 is enclosed for information.

3) All the field offices are requested to pursue the matter with their link branches of
SBI, if the problem persists.

4. This has approval of RPFC-I (F&A)

Yours faithfully,

EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND ORGANISATION (EPFO)
NEW TRICKLE FEED FILE MECHANISM

SINGLE DEBIT-MULTIPLE CREDITS(SMC)
FOR UPLOADING SALARY/PENSION FILES

We refer to the captioned topic and advise that we have been receiving complaints from
EPFO stating that some branches are still not uploading credit files through Single debit-
Multiple Credit (SMC) as per the new trickle feed mechanism.

2 In this connection, please advise Branches under your control to abide by instructions
contained in e-Circular No NBG/CIIBR-ACC EXCEL/2/2014-15 dated 19/11/2014 detailing the
new trickle feed file mechanism . Please also instruct branches to stop using SAL /PNS for
Salary/ pension upload as they can be posted without credit validation.

3, Please arrange accordingly
